name: Data Validation
role: QC gate verifying 7 physical datasets, units, ranges, and lag chains

name: GIS & Spatial
role: Calculates offshore distance, EEZ zone, restricted areas, nearest harbours

name: Ocean Analysis
role: Evaluates waves, swell period, wind-wave steepness, currents, and SST

name: Satellite Analysis
role: Processes chlorophyll-a and ocean colour (ISRO OCM-3 & NOAA CoastWatch)

name: Weather & Hazard
role: Tracks cyclonic depressions, WMO 34kn gales, lightning, and squalls

name: Map Synoptic
role: Extracts isobars, high/low pressure centers, and synoptic features

name: Marine Ecology
role: Synthesizes thermal fronts and chlorophyll gradients into productivity scores

name: Fisheries/PFZ
role: Correlates official INCOIS PFZ lines with live SST/Chlorophyll fronts

name: Anomaly Detection
role: Computes z-scores comparing today vs 2024-2025 seasonal climatology

name: Marine Risk
role: Executes non-linear worst-case fold across ocean, weather, and land risk

name: Orchestrator
role: Coordinates agent dispatch, validates dependencies, synthesizes final advice
